mentions.name: Produktly
mentions.description: This SaaS platform provides product adoption tooling, letting teams build onboarding flows, collect user feedback, and communicate in-app using no-code builders. It also offers a REST API and an MCP server that support building almost any widget, so users can have their favorite AI agent work with Produktly.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building my own product, Produktly. An all-in-one SaaS platform for product adoption. Allows you to build onboarding flows, add feedback collection, and communicate in-app, all with no-code builders.

https://produktly.com

Most recently been expanding our REST API and MCP server to support building almost any widget, making it possible for people to use their favorite AI agent with Produktly.
